body.objective: Determine how the selected compensator repair changes the Einstein-image/additional-Weyl exact sequence, symplectic form and charge-sector obstruction theory.
body.stop_condition: Import the A/B comparison verdict and selected action/carrier hashes, refusing an ambiguous or NEITHER result. Derive the complete on-shell linear inclusion into the selected changed theory and its quotient/cofiber, including any scalaron or topological global branch. Compute the induced Lee-Wald/current forms, lifted residual action and five stabilizer charge maps in common coordinates. Decide whether Einstein inclusion remains exact, whether the additional fourth-order branch changes multiplicity or pairing, and whether fixed- versus variable-charge second-order obstructions are preserved, enlarged or removed. Emit one exact-sequence and charge comparison certificate with an independent direct field-equation/current verifier. Do not promote on-shell inclusion to an off-shell BV chain map or nonlinear closure.
body.current_gate: Einstein/extra/charge anatomy of the selected changed action
body.forbid: no analysis of an unselected or hybrid action; no reuse of pure-Weyl branch labels without an explicit dictionary; no on-shell inclusion promoted to off-shell BV, observable or nonlinear equivalence; no positivity, particle, scattering or unitarity claim
body.resource_hint: DOWNSTREAM GATED. This is the Einstein-team consumer of the exact selected action, not a continuation of the naive compensator exact sequence.
notes: Candidate A may add a scalar quotient; Candidate B may add a global topological quotient. Neither may be silently omitted.
The charge-sector comparison must use the same boundary and coupling choices as the A/B gate.
